title: Demetriou 与三位共同发起人
claim_text: Chris Demetriou 是官方沿革所列四位发起人之一，并见于核心组历任成员名单。

publisher_title: The History of the NetBSD Project
notes: 第二源历任名单收 Chris G. Demetriou；名单顺序不等于位次，题面不称“首位”

title: 官方沿革页列出四位发起人

title: 386BSD 补丁受阻促成另立项目

quote: Frustration with the quality of patches in the wild and the inability to get patches included in 386BSD led to the founding of the NetBSD project in 1993.
publisher_title: The History of the NetBSD Project
notes: 第二源：NetBSD 0.8 was released on 19th April 1993, heavily based on 386BSD 0.1, but with many improvements.

title: 架构独立写进最早的立项目标

quote: NetBSD's original focus was quality and architecture independence.
publisher_title: The History of the NetBSD Project
notes: 第二源：provides a portable system, which runs on many hardware platforms

title: 可移植目标落在 MD 与 MI 分层
